note: Query -> the endpoint that should answer it. `maxRank` is the worst position the expected endpoint may occupy in the top 8, pinned at what the scorer does today; tighten it when the ranker improves, never loosen one without saying why. `miss` records a query the scorer does not serve at all, with the reason, and `defect` names the mechanism responsible so the misses can be counted by cause rather than one at a time. `group` is the entity or query style the case exercises, for per-area reporting. Authored against the tm index; queries are what a caller would actually type, including paraphrases that avoid the product's own words.
